Kowalski gives the Ph.D. thesis in infectious diseases to two post-doctoral fellows. Ms. Kowalski speaks with well-known animal scientist Prof. Anthony Long to discover her lifelong passion for marine conservation.
Dr. Kowalski conducts what are termed “coral reef studies” to learn about ecosystem variability in ocean ecosystems both worldwide and in the coral island of Cebu, Philippines.
